info.title: GridSentinel
info.description: Simulated infrastructure, real reference-backed vulnerability evidence and experimental explainable risk prioritization. No incident probability is claimed.

get.description: The real product and version each fictional asset is assumed to run.

Plausible cyber routes from exposed entry points to critical assets, using the latest
simulation's vulnerability evidence. Reachability is not compromise.

get.description: The best plausible route to each critical asset, and what it does to services step by step.

If this asset were taken over: where it could spread, and how to contain it.

limitation.title: Limitation
limitation.default: Product/version applicability to a declared simulated component; exploit prerequisites and successful compromise are not established.

AssetHistory.title: AssetHistory
AssetHistory.description: Real vulnerability history of the assumed product family up to the snapshot.

AssumedProduct.title: AssumedProduct
AssumedProduct.description: The real product and version a fictional asset is ASSUMED to run (scenario assumption).

Backtest.title: Backtest
Backtest.description: What actually happened after the simulated date, from the real KEV catalog.

Consequence.title: Consequence
Consequence.description: Downstream effect of the target, from the operational dependency graph. Reporting only.

MatchSummary.title: MatchSummary
MatchSummary.description: How NVD affected-version ranges relate to the assumed version.

OperationalDependencyEdge.title: OperationalDependencyEdge
OperationalDependencyEdge.description: source provider -> target dependent, never an access path.

PooledBacktest.title: PooledBacktest
PooledBacktest.description: Held-out months pooled: how often this city's applicable CVEs later entered real KEV.

unavailable_reason.title: Unavailable Reason
unavailable_reason.default: Risk engine is not implemented in Phase 1

RouteFrame.title: RouteFrame
RouteFrame.description: The state of the city after the attacker has reached this step of the route.

ScenarioEvent.title: ScenarioEvent
ScenarioEvent.description: An authored scenario event: part of the simulation, never an observed incident.

WorstScenario.title: WorstScenario
WorstScenario.description:
Worst plausible consequence if an attacker pivots along configured routes.

Reachability is a configured route, not a successful compromise; the effect at each target
is an explicit assumption.
